description.zh: 把官方模型菜单的「推理等级」改成一条可拖动的连续滑条：iOS 26 式液态玻璃珠子、随拖动速度倾斜出落差并在松手后荡波的水面、弹性吸附落档，另支持键盘 ←/→ 调档与 ↑/↓ 切 Flash/Pro、Home/End 跳两端、悬停滚轮调档。零依赖、不联网、不读凭据、不写文件。
description.en: Turns the official reasoning-effort menu row into a draggable continuous slider: an iOS-26 style liquid-glass knob, a velocity-tilted water fill that sloshes when it settles, magnetic snap-to-nearest, plus keyboard (arrows, Home/End) and hover-wheel stepping. Zero dependencies, no network, no credentials, no file writes.
